Container.Name: meeting-diarizer
Container.Overview: Speaker-diarized transcription. Pyannote diarizes (GPU, lazy-loaded, idle-released); transcription is delegated to a remote wyoming-faster-whisper instance over TCP. Requires a Wyoming Whisper server reachable on the network — by default the one at 192.168.1.25:10300.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Stores model cache and speaker enrollment embeddings

Config.Name: HF_TOKEN
Config.Description: HuggingFace access token — required to download pyannote models

Config.Name: WYOMING_HOST
Config.Description: Hostname or IP of the wyoming-faster-whisper server.

Config.Name: WYOMING_PORT
Config.Description: TCP port of the wyoming-faster-whisper server.

Config.Name: WYOMING_LANGUAGE
Config.Description: Language code passed to Wyoming on each transcribe request.

Config.Name: WHISPER_MODELS
Config.Description: Optional named backends for A/B testing different Whisper model sizes. Format: 'medium:10300,large:10302' (hosts inherit WYOMING_HOST) or 'medium=host:port,large=host:port'. When set, requests to /transcribe accept a `model` form field.

Config.Name: WHISPER_DEFAULT
Config.Description: Name of the WHISPER_MODELS entry to use when a request omits the `model` field. Leave blank to fall back to WYOMING_HOST/WYOMING_PORT.

Config.Name: IDLE_RELEASE_SECONDS
Config.Description: Seconds of inactivity after which the pyannote models are released from GPU. Set higher if you do bursts of requests; lower to free VRAM sooner.

Config.Name: DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Internal container data path — do not change
